parameters.content:
## Start
Runs at 08:00 on the 20th of each month and plans next month's boxes. **Run Now** does the same on demand: POST with the header `X-Run-Now-Secret` and an optional `month` (this month or next, `YYYY-MM`). A wrong secret gets 401, a bad month 400, missing settings 500 plus an alert. A good call gets 202 right away.

nodes.name: Note: One Run At A Time

parameters.content:
## 1. One run at a time
The run writes its Sync Log row, waits 2 seconds and lists the curation runs that are still open. If another one started first (a double click, Run Now during the monthly run), this run stops before reading anything, so stock is never reserved twice.

## 2. Read the base
Five reads, 500 ms apart: Active subscribers, every bar, Released batches, and 13 months of Box History and Box Shipments. Each read names its fields, so a renamed allergen field stops the run instead of looking empty. A rate limit (429) is waited out for 31 seconds and the run starts again, at most twice.

## 3. Plan every box
Longest tenure first. Bars must suit every dietary need (allergen fields, cross-checked with the ingredients, name, flavor notes and chocolate type), avoid dislikes and the last REPEAT_WINDOW boxes, and have stock with more than SELL_BY_BUFFER_DAYS left at ship date. Flavor families are balanced. A last check reads every chosen bar's allergen fields again. Subscribers who already have a box this month are skipped, but its bars are checked against their needs again.

## 4. Write one box at a time
For each box: reserve the stock on its batches, upsert the Box Shipment on Shipment ID, then upsert one Box History row per bar. One box per pass, so a retry can never double anything. A rate limit (429) waits 31 seconds and repeats the pass, which is safe because every step is. If a box cannot be saved, the run first asks Airtable whether it was saved after all, and only then gives its stock back. The next run skips saved boxes and carries on.

## When the run stops
Every failure after the start closes the Sync Log row as Failed (so the next run is not held back), then stops the run. The error workflow posts the reason to the ops channel.

## 5. Report
One Slack message to the packing channel: first any bar to take out of a box planned before, then the counts and every box of the month that is not full, and why. Then the Sync Log row gets its counts and a Finished At. If either fails, the boxes stay saved and the run ends with an alert.
